name: Alderney ferry departures
task: Find a dated schedule and a departure time for the Alderney ferry to Halifax.

checks.label: A clock time in the published example

note: A saved timetable can answer this task. Its service date belongs to Halifax Next; a successful check does not establish a live sailing.

name: Halifax Transit ferry routes
task: Find the Alderney and Woodside ferry services on the municipal page.
note: This checks whether a reader can identify both services, independent of timetable changes.

name: Dartmouth ferry landing photographs
task: Find the dated Dartmouth ferry photographs and their archive links.
note: The archive links must be visible. This checks the viewpoint page; the linked archive viewers have their own requirements.

name: Halifax Time Lens map controls
task: Switch the right-hand map layer to the 2025 satellite scene and read its updated label.

checks.label: Right-hand label changes to the satellite scene

note: This task needs the interactive map control. The separate Dartmouth archive page offers a permanent three-year comparison.

name: Chebucto Community Net
task: Find the community network’s description of dial-up access on its legacy page.
note: The visit is to a public website. It does not use a Chebucto access account or dial-up line.

name: Vancouver Community Network
task: Locate VCN’s public account sign-up link.
note: The check ends at the public link and does not open or submit an account form. It does not measure VCN’s access network.

name: The World Wide Web project
task: Find the preserved project page’s technical-details link.
note: This is the historical document hosted on the present-day W3C site.

name: NPR text-only news
task: Find a news headline that links to an article from the text-only front page.
note: The headline itself changes. The check looks for an article link on the index and does not assess the full article.
